segments.text: enhanced button an extension of the default shadon button component this Innovation is set to redefine the way you approach button Styles and features
in your projects enhanced button takes the familiar shadon button and introduces a spectrum of new and aesthetically
pleasing Styles elevate your design game with styles that go beyond the ordinary adding a touch of diversity to the
shadon design system seamlessly integrating new features into the enhanced button component it's not just
about looks it's about enhancing user interactions enjoy an enriched user experience without the hassle of

it takes to expand the regular shadon button component developers can now effortlessly introduce new Styles and
features without creating additional components or diving into extensive code elevate your shads and experience with
enhanced button where flexibility meets simplicity
